articles.intent_note: Full-finish shelf: the finish carries both its own paint look and its own shine.
articles.paint_advice: It brings its own colours, so leave BASE COLOR on the finish's own colour. Put it next to a plain zone of the opposite sheen (matte beside gloss, warm beside cool) so the colours have a calm neighbour. Avoid: numbers lost in the veining, next to other patterned finishes.

combos.why: Patterns that suit it: bold white or yellow stripes and lettering: crisp on the dark base; big block graphics: the sparse line art stays behind
Patterns to avoid: other speckle, contour or squiggle patterns: line on line; fine grids or carbon: lost on the dark ground
Spec overlays that work: gloss/matte stripe bands: shiny bars on the semi-matte base; fine metal flake: gives real sparkle to the specks
Judge the paint and the shine together: the same spec looks different under different colours.
